name: fabric-calendar
description: Let ChatGPT schedule your day, organize your task list and more with the Fabric desktop app.

interface.shortDescription: Plan your day and your tasks
interface.longDescription:
Connect ChatGPT to Fabric, a personal calendar and task list app on your Mac. Ask what's on your schedule, turn notes and meetings into tasks, block out time to work on them, mark them done, and review how a past week actually went: what was planned, what was worked, and what slipped.

Fabric shows your tasks next to the events from your Google or Apple calendars, so ChatGPT plans around your real commitments. You choose whether ChatGPT can only view your tasks, schedule and projects, or also create and change them.

Who it's for: people who run their day from a calendar and a task list and want to plan and capture work in conversation.

Requirements and limitations: Fabric must be installed on your Mac and running, because your data stays on your Mac and the Mac answers each request. You sign in with a Fabric account when you connect. Fabric can't read other people's calendars, send email or messages, or delete tasks.
capabilities: View your schedule and task list
defaultPrompt: Add a task to send the Q3 report by Friday.

positive.expected_behavior: Lists today's tasks, time blocks and calendar events from the test account in start-time order, in the account's time zone.

positive.description: Create a task with a due day
positive.prompt: Add a task to send the Q3 report by Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks for an existing matching task, then creates 'Send the Q3 report' due this Friday and confirms the date. The task appears in Fabric on the test Mac.

positive.prompt: Block two hours tomorrow afternoon to work on the launch plan.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds open time tomorrow afternoon around existing events, proposes a two-hour block, and after confirmation creates it on the calendar.

positive.prompt: How did last week go? What did I actually work on?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises last week's planned versus worked time per task from the returned minutes. On a new account with nothing planned last week, it says so plainly instead of inventing work.

positive.prompt: Mark the task 'Send the Q3 report' as done.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the task created in the earlier case and sets it to done, then confirms. The checkbox is ticked in Fabric on the Mac. If the task doesn't exist yet, it says no matching task was found.

negative.description: Sending messages is out of scope
negative.prompt: Email my team that the launch moved to Thursday.

negative.description: Other people's calendars are not accessible
negative.prompt: Show me my coworker Alex's calendar for tomorrow.

review.commerce_description: Fabric Calendar does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: view your schedule, capture and schedule tasks, mark them done, and review a past week.
